## Notes

Ally Duo arcade mode on Sanhok, 17 June to 1 July 2026; AI companion Ella powered by an on-device small language model built on NVIDIA ACE with speech-to-text and text-to-speech; fast actions (movement, item collection) with minimal latency, strategy from game context and conversation; Korean, Chinese, English.
